title: Engaging Kids With Robotic Exoskeletons and Gamification
official: Engaging Kids and Improving Rehab Outcomes by Gamification of Robotic Exoskeletons Combined With Proprioceptive Biofeedback
summary: Conduct a clinical field trial at CHOA's Day Rehab Program using the clinical exoskeleton in conjunction with visual biofeedback with pediatric patients who present with genu recurvatum or crouch gait over 5 rehabilitation visits.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 4-21 years
* Clinical presence of genu recurvatum or crouch gait during walking
* Ability to walk nonstop for at least 6 minutes
* Willing to participate in 5 sessions of therapy with the device with each session lasting no more than 2 hours

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to take commands from research staff
* Receipt of Botox injection during study trial will disqualify the participant from participating further
* Presence of uncontrolled seizures
* Non-English speaking

sites.f: Children's Healthcare of Atlanta - Scottish Rite
